GPE.narrative: You are a group of 6 journalists visiting a desert town near the border. You are supposed to file a report and leave the town by 1700 hours before the border gates close. It is currently 1400 hours. A local informant rushes to you and tells you: 1. A terror group is planning to ambush a military supply convoy passing through the town at 1530 hours. 2. A child has fallen into a dry borewell 5 km away and needs immediate rescue. 3. Your jeep has a punctured tire and the spare is missing. 4. A sandstorm is predicted to hit the area at 1600 hours, which will halt all movement. The nearest army base is 10 km away. The nearest hospital with rescue equipment is 15 km away in the opposite direction. A local mechanic is 2 km away but he doesn't have a vehicle. How will you divide your group and prioritize these tasks to save lives and exit safely?

GTO.PGT: Progressive Group Task: 4 progressive obstacles over varied terrain (sand and grass). Resources: 1 Plank, 2 Ballis (short and long), 1 Rope. Time: 45 mins. Color rules strictly enforced.
GTO.HGT: Half Group Task: 1 complex obstacle involving a cantilever mechanism. Resources: 1 Plank, 1 Rope. Time: 15 mins.
GTO.IO: Individual Obstacles: 10 obstacles (Tarzan Swing, Double Ditch, Screen Jump, Commando Walk, Zig-Zag Balance, High Screen Jump, Burma Bridge, Tarzan Swing, Tiger Leap, Rope Climbing). Time: 3 mins.
GTO.FGT: Final Group Task: 1 long obstacle requiring the entire group to cross a wide 'poisonous' ditch. Resources: Plank, Balli, Rope, Steel Drum. Time: 15 mins.
